summary: 1470 Owens Street is a UCSF parking structure at Mission Bay serving multiple UCSF life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices, designed by WRNS Studio. DataSF Assessor records and the project's structural engineer both date its completion to 2020.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #201806010826 filed to erect the parking garage
Parking structure completed (4-story structure per the Assessor roll; the structural engineer's own project page also lists 2020 as the completion year).

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 8709019, 1470 Owens St): year_property_built 2020
Building Permits: permit #201806010826 (1470 Owens St, block 8709 lot 019), filed 2018-06-01, "erect a parking garage type 2b", completed 2020-10-20
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2020 completion is not sourced, only the year.

A separate WRNS Studio project page (wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/) lists a 'UCSF Mission Bay Parking Structure' completed in 2012 -- this conflicts with the 2020 date and, given the address-specific Watry Design page and the Assessor's own parcel-tagged year both agree on 2020, is treated here as describing a different, earlier UCSF Mission Bay garage (there is more than one on the campus, e.g. the separately-listed Owens Street Garage at 1625 Owens St), not this parcel. Not independently confirmed which building the WRNS page depicts.
